Author: Meowick
Name: Emote Plugin
Punchline: Manage and use custom emotes with Penumbra mod integration.
Description: An emote management plugin with Penumbra mod association. Add/remove/rename/duplicate emotes, auto-toggle Penumbra mods, search and organize your emote collection. Use /emotes to open.
Changelog: Reworked sit/ground sit/doze pose selection (game pose order, direct entry, single /cpose switches, shorter doze lying-awake, optional transition skip); emotes wait for Penumbra's redraw; scanner remembers skipped mods and adds search/filters; playback trace settings; latest Penumbra API.
